2115141487478685784.en_summary: $TSLA Tesla CFO Vaibhav Taneja: Tesla ended Q3 with its highest vehicle backlog in four years. "On the automotive business, we exited the quarter with our highest backlog in 4 years, with deliveries constrained primarily by production. We are, therefore, focused on increasing production at all our factories to meet this growing demand."
2115141487478685784.zh_summary: $TSLA Tesla CFO Vaibhav Taneja：Tesla在Q3結束時擁有四年來最高的車輛積壓訂單。「在汽車業務方面，我們以四年來最高的積壓訂單結束本季度，交付主要受生產限制。因此，我們專注於提高所有工廠的生產以滿足這一不斷增長的需求。」

2115141137623298216.en_summary: In the last 36 months, the $SPX has had only 3 months where it dropped greater than -2.50% at the end of the month. April 2024, March 2025, March 2026. So for 2027, expect another bigly down month come Mar/April? I mean why not right?

2115140705173839872.en_summary: My opinion is that stocks like $LITE, $NBIS, $BE, and $CRDO will heavily outperform memory names like $SNDK and $MU from here. AI is so heavily doubted as is so why take on the second risk that memory is still cyclical? Networking, power, and compute are genuinely undeniable.
